parameters.content:
## Pension Helper – Payment Checker (everyone)
Runs on the 5th of every month (or press "Run now").

1. Reads every pensioner and every pension payment
2. Works out expected vs received pension for each month, and life certificate status
3. Saves one line per pensioner to the run_log table

**Demo DA rates live in "Check every pensioner". Keep them the same as the Dashboard API workflow.**
